prefix: In-game screenshot of a polished stylized 3D action-adventure game set in Hyehwa-dong, Seoul, Korea, inside a basement MMA gym.
common: RENDERING STYLE: cel-shaded 3D that reads like a flat-colored anime background painting. Every surface is a flat color area with exactly one crisp shadow tone (a warm grey multiply of the base color, never black or muddy), thin warm-black ink outlines (#1A1417) on silhouettes, beams, frames and object edges; outlines get thinner with distance. No gradients on walls, no photographic textures, no realistic dirt: materials are suggested only by sparse hand-drawn marks (a few ink dots, short hatching strokes, mat seams). Muted low-saturation palette, subtle paper grain over the whole image, gentle split toning. SETTING: a basement MMA gym under a busy street in Hyehwa-dong, Seoul: one big low room about 20 by 13 meters with a 3.2 m ceiling of exposed raw grey concrete (#B9B6AF) with square concrete beams, two round grey ventilation ducts and a few conduit pipes; rows of cool-white twin-tube fluorescent light fixtures (#EAF0EC) hanging on short rods, their light slightly greenish; walls with a dark grey-green painted lower band (#4F5B55) about 1.2 m high and a cream upper wall (#E3D5B8); black rubber floor with pale speckles (#3A3A3A); a large area of interlocking puzzle mats in muted blue (#4A6B8A) with a cream border strip; one small black-steel octagonal cage about 6 m across with dark-red padded posts (#7A3A32), black chain-link mesh fence and an off-white canvas floor (#E8E2D6) raised one step; six heavy bags, black and dark red, hanging from a steel rail under a ceiling beam along one wall; a small weight corner with a barbell rack, dumbbell rack, flat bench, kettlebells, a tractor tire and a coiled battle rope; a small office in the corner with a big clear-glass window in an aluminium frame, inside a desk, an office chair, a steel cabinet, a champion belt mounted on a plain wooden plaque and one framed old fight poster that is only a picture with no text; a mirror wall; a row of grey steel lockers; a stand fan, a water dispenser, a wall round-timer box, a whiteboard on a stand, a steel shoe rack with a heap of rubber slippers, blank solid-color posters on the walls. Shapes are clean and readable like a real-time 3D game built from modular pieces, yet rich in props. CAMERA: third-person over-the-shoulder game camera, lens height about 1.7 m, 35 mm lens, natural eye-level perspective. The reference image shows the player character: draw him small, seen from behind, standing at the lower left third and filling about one third of the image height; in the gym he wears a plain dark grey t-shirt and black shorts, barefoot. No HUD, no UI, no watermark. All posters, boards, banners and the belt plaque are blank solid color panels with at most simple abstract shapes: absolutely no letters, no Korean or English text, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks anywhere. No alcohol, no cigarettes.

items.name: g01_stairs_overview
items.prompt: SCENE: afternoon, quiet. The camera stands on the lower steps of the entrance staircase coming down from the street: bare concrete steps with a dark green steel handrail, one bare fluorescent tube over the stairs, a steel shoe rack and a heap of rubber slippers at the bottom. Looking out over the whole room from slightly above: the blue puzzle mat area at the left with the mirror wall beyond it, the octagonal cage at center-right, the row of six heavy bags along the far right wall, the weight corner at the far left under the beams, and the lit office window at the far back. Two or three members train quietly: one shadow-boxes in the mirror, one stretches on the mat. The player character walks down the last steps, seen from behind.

items.name: g02_cage_sparring
items.prompt: SCENE: evening peak hour. The camera is just inside the open cage door looking across the off-white canvas; the black chain-link fence and dark-red padded posts frame the shot, four small spotlights on a square truss above the cage light the canvas brighter than the rest of the gym. The player character, seen from behind at the lower left, wears a black open-face headgear and MMA gloves and faces a 24-year-old athletic Korean man with short hair shaved at the sides, in a black rash guard and black shorts who also wears headgear and gloves, circling in a light sparring stance two meters away. Outside the cage, the head coach: a 38-year-old Korean man, a retired pro champion, 175 cm with a lean hard bantamweight build, an oval face with a clean strong jawline, straight nose, straight medium-thick eyebrows and calm narrow eyes, black hair parted at the side and swept back with a soft fringe falling to one side, short at the sides; plain dark grey gym t-shirt, black training pants with a thin white side stripe, rubber slippers, a white towel around his neck stands at the open cage door with his arms folded, watching closely. Beyond the fence, rows of heavy bags and members on the mats under the fluorescent lights.

items.name: g03_mats_bags
items.prompt: SCENE: evening peak hour, the room is full. The camera stands at the edge of the blue puzzle mat area: six or seven members in rash guards and shorts drill sprawls and shadow-boxing in two lines facing the mirror wall; along the right wall, the row of six black and dark-red heavy bags hangs from the steel rail, two members hitting them with the bags swinging; the wall round-timer box glows with a red light; towels and water bottles lie along the mat border; the player character skips rope at the lower left, seen from behind, the rope a thin ink line. Fluorescent light fixtures run in rows overhead under the concrete beams.

items.name: g04_weight_corner
items.prompt: SCENE: morning, 10 am, the gym just opened, almost empty, cool light. The camera looks into the small weight corner under the ceiling beams next to a square concrete column: a black steel barbell rack with a loaded bar, a two-tier dumbbell rack with hex dumbbells, a flat bench, three kettlebells of different sizes on the rubber floor, a big worn tractor tire lying flat, a thick coiled battle rope, a stand fan, a water dispenser and a whiteboard on a stand. the head coach: a 38-year-old Korean man, a retired pro champion, 175 cm with a lean hard bantamweight build, an oval face with a clean strong jawline, straight nose, straight medium-thick eyebrows and calm narrow eyes, black hair parted at the side and swept back with a soft fringe falling to one side, short at the sides; plain dark grey gym t-shirt, black training pants with a thin white side stripe, rubber slippers, a white towel around his neck sits on the bench with a paper cup of coffee, speaking to the player character, who stands at the lower left seen from behind holding a jump rope. Beyond them the quiet mats and the cage.

items.name: g05_office_window
items.prompt: SCENE: afternoon. The camera stands on the mat border looking through the big clear-glass office window set in an aluminium frame in the cream wall; a door with a small glass pane is beside it. Inside the small office: a plain wooden desk with a laptop and a stack of papers, a black office chair, a grey steel cabinet, a small shelf with gloves and mitts, on the back wall a champion belt mounted on a plain wooden plaque and beside it one framed old fight poster that is only a picture of two fighters with no text, a wall clock. the head coach: a 38-year-old Korean man, a retired pro champion, 175 cm with a lean hard bantamweight build, an oval face with a clean strong jawline, straight nose, straight medium-thick eyebrows and calm narrow eyes, black hair parted at the side and swept back with a soft fringe falling to one side, short at the sides; plain dark grey gym t-shirt, black training pants with a thin white side stripe, rubber slippers, a white towel around his neck sits at the desk writing in a notebook with a focus mitt lying beside it. The player character stands outside the glass at the lower left, seen from behind, hesitating to knock. Reflections in the glass are a few thin pale diagonal strokes only.

items.name: g06_night_coaching
items.prompt: SCENE: late night, 11 pm, after closing. Most of the fluorescent fixtures are off; only the four small spotlights over the cage and one fluorescent fixture near the mats are on, so the far parts of the room fade into warm dark grey shadow with the heavy bags as dark silhouettes. On the blue mat at the edge of the cage, the head coach: a 38-year-old Korean man, a retired pro champion, 175 cm with a lean hard bantamweight build, an oval face with a clean strong jawline, straight nose, straight medium-thick eyebrows and calm narrow eyes, black hair parted at the side and swept back with a soft fringe falling to one side, short at the sides; plain dark grey gym t-shirt, black training pants with a thin white side stripe, rubber slippers, a white towel around his neck in slippers holds up a pair of focus mitts at chest height, half-lit, calling a combination; the player character, seen from behind at the lower left, is mid-punch into the mitt with a small ink impact mark. A towel and a water bottle lie on the mat, the office window at the back is dark. Quiet, focused, intimate mood.
